title: Tianyicraft-Soundpack
description: A music add-on pack of PearlLuo's "Tianyicraft" that let you play Minecraft also have the company of Luo Tianyi ~
body:
# Tianyicraft音乐附加包
## **免责声明**
**本资源包由洛天依粉丝创建，与洛天依任何官方无关。所有内容均出于对角色和社区的热爱和尊重。**
## 这是什么？
- Tianyicraft 音乐附加包是存储了世界首位中文虚拟歌手洛天依(Luo Tianyi)的歌曲的，适用于 Minecraft 1.20+ 的资源包，搭配 [Tianyicraft 主资源包](https://github.com/Pearl-Luo/Tianyicraft)食用更佳～

## 里面有什么？
- 资源包里内置一些洛天依的背景音乐，1.21.6+ 版本可以打开`显示共鸣曲框`以及将`天依歌唱频率`调整为`跃动不息`体验更佳。
## 如何加载这个资源包？
- 下载以后放入 `resourcepacks` 这个文件夹即可
- 如果你同时在使用 Tianyicraft 主资源包，请将其置于主包之上以避免奇怪的 Bug
## 关于开源
- 本资源包与 Tianyicraft 主资源包同样遵循 MIT 开源协议，你可以：
- 修改并二次发布，以及在`"title.credits": "作者：@B-0712天依號A359" `这一行修改为你的名称，但必须在 credits.json 标上我与主资源包创作者（B-0712天依號A359）的名称。
- 你不可以：
- 在任何情况下宣称 Tianyicraft 及其音乐附加包是由你制作或归你所有。

**以下为英文描述/Below are the English description**
# Tianyicraft Music Add-on
## **Disclaimer**
**This resource pack is created by fans of Luo Tianyi and has no affiliation with any official Luo Tianyi entity. All content is made out of love and respect for the character and the community.**

## What is this?
- The Tianyicraft Music Add-on is a resource pack for Minecraft 1.20+ that contains songs by Luo Tianyi, the world's first Chinese virtual singer. It pairs best with the [Tianyicraft main resource pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/tianyicraft).

## What's inside?
- The pack includes some of Luo Tianyi's background music, which can be loaded using the “Reactive Music” mod.

## How to load this resource pack?
- After downloading, simply place it into the `resourcepacks` folder.
- If you are also using the Tianyicraft main resource pack, make sure to place this add-on above the main pack to avoid strange bugs.

## About open source
- This resource pack, like the Tianyicraft main resource pack, follows the MIT open source license. You may:
- Modify and redistribute it, and change the line `"title.credits": "Author: @B-0712天依號A359"` to your own name, but you must credit both me and the creator of the main resource pack (B-0712天依號A359) in credits.json.
- You may not:
- Under any circumstances claim that Tianyicraft and its Music Add-on were made by or belong to you.
